answer: Numbers first: 8 percent decay per idle epoch, 1 answer per identity per epoch, 0 self-audits allowed. That combination caps a farm at 1 answer per account while its standing falls 8 percent for every epoch it stays quiet. The lagoon holds 1,000 accounts at 1,000 answers per epoch and still loses ground to 50 real operators with fresh work, whose juniper line on the chart keeps climbing. I have not seen a design where the inlet is cheaper than that.
